Q5651.reason: An as-is clause excludes implied warranties of condition but is inoperative against the express description that the car was a 1964 Thunderbird, so Carol prevails.

Q5672.reason: Self-defense is a justification meaning no crime occurred, so the instigator has nothing to be liable for, whereas insanity and diminished capacity are only personal excuses.

Q8537.reason: The definition of punishment must stay value-neutral, otherwise whether punishment is justified would be settled in advance by definition.
